title: VeloraOS 1.10.30 - Mobile Sheet + Update Reconnect Hotfix
releaseNotes: Fixes the mobile Chat plus menu showing only a blurred or dimmed page instead of the controls sheet.
Removes backdrop blur and forces the mobile controls sheet above the dim overlay with reliable hidden-state rules.
Fixes successful updates getting stuck on Restarting Web UI or repeatedly asking for another Web UI restart.
Successful non-reboot updates now finish automatically after reconnect and perform at most one cache-busting reload.
Changes the completed update action to Done and records a final ready state in the dedicated update service.
Preserves Knowledge, hardware-aware Coding, automatic web research and Lockdown mode.
